findings.description: At 0:00-0:10 the truck outside is a white/silver conventional sleeper-cab semi tractor towing a long box trailer; at 1:43-1:52 the man exits and walks to a dark green single-unit box truck with an integral cargo body and chrome stacks. Body type, configuration, and color all differ, so this is not a lighting/angle artifact. The story-time gap (pre-dawn to sunrise) could allow an off-screen swap, but no swap is shown or implied by any second vehicle, and the scene reads as the same truck he arrived in — an unexplained identity discontinuity.
